jobs.description: Cookie Statement Company ← Back About Blog Newsroom Careers Privacy Cookie Statements Platform Blog Contact Get in touch Cookie Statement Last updated: Aug 6, 2026 Insait IO LTD, operating under the name of Encore AI (“Encore”, “we”, “us”, “our”), uses certain monitoring and tracking technologies, such as cookies, beacons, pixels, tags and scripts (“Cookies”). We use these technologies to maintain, provide and improve our website and platform, and to give visitors, users and customers a better experience. This Statement explains how Encore uses Cookies. It describes what these technologies are and why we use them, and it sets out your rights to control our use of them. It also provides some useful links for further reading. If this Statement does not answer your question, or if you have further questions about our use of Cookies, please contact us at contact@gainencore.ai . For more information about how we handle personal data, please see our Privacy Policy . What Are Cookies? Cookies are a widely used web technology that lets a website store and retrieve certain information on a user’s device and recognize returning visitors. Encore and its third-party partners may collect information about your use of our website using Cookies. Cookies can help us recognize you when you return, find ways to improve the site, and reveal traffic patterns so we can identify the most useful parts of the site. Cookies can be first-party or third-party. A first-party cookie is one you receive directly from us when you use our website. A third-party cookie is one set by another party. We do not control what third parties do on their own websites. We may, however, work with selected third-party providers whose cookies operate through our site so we can understand your experience with the site and measure its performance. A persistent cookie is stored on your device by the web browser until it expires or you delete it. Its expiration is set by the party that created it, either on a fixed date or after a period of inactivity. For the life of the cookie, its information is sent to that party each time you visit the site it belongs to, or another site configured to read it. A session cookie, by contrast, is created temporarily for the duration of your visit. It may store information you enter and track your activity within the site, and it is deleted when you leave the site or close your browser. What Types of Cookies Do We Use? Encore and its third-party partners use the following types of Cookies: Strictly Necessary Cookies: cookies that are required for our website to operate. Performance Cookies: cookies that let us recognize and count visitors and see how users move around the site, which helps us improve how it works. Functional Cookies: cookies that recognize you when you return, so we can personalize content and remember your preferences. Targeting Cookies: cookies that record information about your browsing behavior so that relevant advertising can be offered based on your interests. They also help limit how often you see an ad and help measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns. Deleting these cookies does not stop advertising from being shown. When you visit or use our website, the information we and our third-party partners may collect using Cookies includes, for example: (i) usage details about your interaction with the site (such as the date, time and length of visits, the specific pages or content you access, search terms, how often you visit, and referring website addresses); (ii) device information, including the IP address and other details of the device you use to connect to the site (such as device type and unique device identifier, operating system, browser type, mobile network information, and the device’s telephone number); and (iii) location information, where you choose to give the site or app access to real-time information about your device’s location. The information generated by Cookies about your use of our website (including your IP address) may be transmitted by us or our third-party partners to locations other than the one in which you reside, including Israel and the United States. Information we collect may be used, alone or combined with information about you obtained from other sources (such as our data partners and offline customer data), to, among other things, deliver advertising tailored to your interests, including advertising related to our products or services when you access other websites, and to better understand how the sites tracked by these third parties are used. This Statement does not apply to, and we are not responsible for, Cookies or other tracking technologies used in third-party advertisements. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of advertisers and ad services to learn about their use of cookies and other tracking technologies. How Are Other Tracking Technologies Used? Cookies are not the only way to recognize or track visitors to a website. From time to time we may use other, similar technologies, such as web beacons (also called “tracking pixels” or “clear gifs”) and JavaScript placed within the code of our website. Web beacons are tiny graphics files containing a unique identifier that let us recognize when someone has visited our site or opened an email we have sent. JavaScript is short code built into our site; these scripts activate when you request a page that contains them and serve a purpose similar to a web beacon, letting us infer that you have opened or done something on a particular page. These technologies let us, for example, monitor how users move from one page to another, count visits, deliver and communicate with Cookies, understand whether you reached our site from an online advertisement on a third-party site, improve site performance, monitor navigation patterns and feature usage, and understand email reads and marketing campaign effectiveness. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: Encore AI builds conversational AI agent platforms for banks, insurers, lenders, and investment houses across Israel, Australia, and the US. We're looking for a Deployment Strategist to own the bridge between what our AI agents can do and what our clients actually need in production. This is not a classic onboarding or support role. You'll sit at the intersection of client strategy, prompt/flow engineering, and delivery ownership — translating a bank's or insurer's operational reality into a working, production-grade AI agent, and translating field learnings back into product and platform improvements. You'll work across our client base in Israel, Australia, and the US. What You'll Own Deployment ownership end-to-end. Take a client engagement from kickoff through go-live and into steady-state, owning the outcome — not just the handoff. Solution design with clients. Run discovery and design workshops with client stakeholders (product owners, compliance, ops leads) to translate business requirements into agent flows, node logic, and conversation design. Hands-on configuration. Work directly in the Encore AI platform — flow JSON, conversation/collect/end nodes, prompt engineering — to build and refine agents, rather than only spec'ing requirements for someone else to build. Executive-level communication. Present progress, risk, and roadmap to client stakeholders ranging from project leads to C-suite, across our Israeli, Australian, and US accounts. Organizational readiness. Help clients (often regulated financial institutions) navigate the process and change-management side of adopting an AI agent — not just the technical rollout. Field-to-product feedback loop. Be the connective tissue between what clients need and what Encore AI builds — surfacing patterns across accounts to Product and Engineering. Risk and escalation management. Identify delivery risk early (timeline, scope, technical blockers) and manage it proactively with both client and internal stakeholders. Reusable playbooks. Build documentation, QA frameworks, and implementation patterns that make the next deployment faster than the last. 3–6 years in a client-facing, technical delivery role — implementation, deployment, solutions engineering, or technical customer success — ideally at an AI/LLM, SaaS, or enterprise software company. Experience that maps to one of these profiles: Delivery/deployment lead at a company shipping AI or data products into production for enterprise clients. Solutions engineer or technical PM who moved toward the client and business side. Strategy or process consultant who wants to own outcomes rather than hand off recommendations. Comfort with ambiguity and technical depth. You don't need to write production code, but you should be comfortable getting into flow logic, JSON configs, and prompt structure yourself. Financial services familiarity is a strong plus — understanding of banking, insurance, or investment workflows, or regulatory/compliance context (KYC, SLAs, risk sign-off processes). English fluency required; Hebrew a strong plus. You'll work across Israeli, Australian, and US accounts — most client-facing work happens in English, with Hebrew needed for Israeli engagements. Executive presence — able to run a room with a client's VP or C-suite as comfortably as a technical working session. Bias toward ownership. Low ego, high follow-through; you take feedback directly and don't need things handed to you fully scoped. ﻿Nice to Have Prior experience with LLM prompt engineering or conversational AI design specifically (not just general software implementation). Experience working with regulated industries beyond finance (healthcare, insurance) where compliance and audit trails shape delivery.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: Encore AI builds the production-grade AI backbone for top-tier enterprises. We don't just wrap LLMs. Our platform autonomously handles mission-critical workflows, replacing operational friction with seamless, predictive experiences. We are a lean, engineering-driven company working directly with the biggest players in the market. An FDE at Encore AI is a customer-embedded engineer who owns the technical success of an AI deployment end to end. You don't advise and hand implementation to someone else. You are the implementation owner. You take an ambiguous business problem, break it into solvable technical components, build the solution on our platform, and stay with it until it works reliably in production. What You'll Do Own deployments end-to-end. From signed deal to production go-live and stabilization. No hand-offs. Build production AI agents. Design and ship agent flows on our platform: prompt engineering, orchestration, edge cases, and the testing discipline that makes them production-grade. Integrate into brownfield reality. Legacy systems, APIs, CRMs, telephony and customer infrastructure, while navigating security, compliance and incomplete requirements. Debug in environments you don't control. When production misbehaves inside the customer's stack, you find it and fix it. Push back with judgment. Challenge poor requirements, find creative alternatives, and align technical and business stakeholders behind them. Be embedded with customers. On-site several days a week during active deployments, often as the most senior technical person in the room. On-site days carry dedicated compensation on top of your salary, and every production go-live carries a milestone bonus. What We Look For Strong software engineering and systems integration fundamentals (Python / Node.js, APIs, data). Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI systems, and comfort using AI tools to move fast yourself. Proven ability to solve complex problems in legacy or enterprise environments. Product judgment, structured problem decomposition, and sound judgment under ambiguity. Clear communication with both engineers and business leaders. Hebrew fluency and strong English. Genuine energy for customer-facing work and measurable business impact. What Success Looks Like The deployment reaches production, withstands real-world constraints, and delivers the intended customer outcome. Not a successful demo. Live, stable, and delivering value. Why Join Us? Your work goes live. Production systems serving customers of the biggest enterprises in the market. Compensation that follows impact. Base plus paid client days plus go-live bonuses. Direct line to the platform. You work with R&D, not around it. What you learn in the field shapes the product. High bar, high trust. We hire few, trust deeply, and expect excellence. Ready for the challenge?
